jobs.occupation: Security Staff - Après-Ski - Winter Season- Vorarlberg (Austria) M/W/X
jobs.description:
Your presence makes the difference.

We are looking for security staff for the winter season at an après-ski venue in St. Anton am Arlberg. You are alert, you have a confident manner and you understand people well. You make sure that guests and the team feel safe and can enjoy après-ski in a relaxed atmosphere.

Your tasks

• Controlling entry and looking after the entrance area
• Ensuring the safety of guests and the team
• Recognising conflicts early and de-escalating them calmly
• Enforcing the house rules in a professional and respectful way 
Your profile

• Minimum age: 21 years
• Impeccable reputation (good character)
• English at level B2 is sufficient. German is not required.
• Reliability and a sense of responsibility
• Physical presence and a confident, assertive manner
• You stay calm and act with good judgement, even in demanding situations.
• Willingness to work at weekends 
Key facts

• Season: January 2027 to Easter 2027 (Easter Sunday is 28 March 2027)
• Shift times: every day, 14:00-20:00, day shifts only
• Working hours: 36 hours per week - 6 days per week, 6 hours per day
• We are looking for 5 people.
Pay

• Employment as a worker (Arbeiter/in) under the Austrian collective agreement for security guards in the security industry (Kollektivvertrag für Wachorgane im Bewachungsgewerbe), employment group B - service and security duties
• At least EUR 13.87 gross per hour (approx. EUR 2,162 gross per month based on 36 hours per week)
• Plus special payments as set out in the collective agreement
• if you have the relevant qualifications and experience, we are of course willing to pay above the collective agreement rate.
What we offer

• EUR 2,200 net per month (approx. EUR 3,045 gross)
• Accommodation is provided free of charge.

jobs.occupation: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) (Architekt/in)
jobs.description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.info

jobs.occupation: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Architektur)
jobs.description: Job Title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Real Estate Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-REND-02 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-REND-02 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is a German research institution operating at the intersection of architectural digitization, environmental resilience, and sustainable development. We combine engineering precision with visual storytelling to present sustainable development concepts, municipal renewal proposals, and investment pitches to decision-makers. Role Overview We are looking for a creative and technically skilled 3D Architectural Visualizer to translate 3D building models and mass studies into photorealistic imagery, architectural perspectives, and presentation-ready visual assets. Key Responsibilities - Produce photorealistic architectural exterior and interior renderings from BIM/CAD geometry (Revit, SketchUp, Rhino). - Set up realistic lighting, material texturing, vegetation, and context environments for urban and commercial real estate assets. - Create mass studies, conceptual 3D volumes, and interactive walkthroughs for project feasibility presentations. - Perform post-production image enhancements and color grading in Adobe Photoshop. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers and research leads to accurately reflect structural design intent. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Visualization, 3D Design, Animation, or related field (e.g., Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture, DUET, or comparable). - Proficiency in industry-standard visualization software: 3ds Max, Blender, Unreal Engine, Lumion, or Corona / V-Ray. - Strong aesthetic sense for architectural composition, atmospheric lighting, and material detailing. - A portfolio showing realistic architectural renderings is required for consideration. - Professional working proficiency in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package matching market rates. - Infrastructure: High-performance rendering hardware and reliable, air-conditioned studio space in DHA. - In-Country Career Growth: Rapid progression to Senior Visualizer or Art Director within our growing studio, with continuous training in real-time engines and computational visualization tools. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Exceptional performers proving dedication and high visual standard over 3–6 months can qualify for an international transfer to our research facilities in Germany (§ 18d AufenthG), fully supported with visa facilitation, relocation, and housing / accommodation support. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

Guidance regarding professional recognition, German language learning, visa procedures, and relocation may be provided, depending on the employer's arrangements.Key Responsibilities- Assess patients' physical, cognitive, psychological, and functional abilities.- Develop and implement individualized treatment plans.- Provide therapeutic interventions to improve daily living skills and independence.- Support patients recovering from injuries, illnesses, neurological conditions, or developmental challenges.- Monitor treatment progress and document therapeutic outcomes.- Collaborate with physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, and other healthcare professionals.- Educate patients and their families on therapeutic exercises and everyday activities.- Maintain accurate patient records and comply with German healthcare standards.Requirements- Completed qualification or degree in Ergotherapy/Occupational Therapy from an accredited institution.- Relevant professional experience is an advantage; motivated recent graduates may also be considered.- Willingness to relocate to Germany.- Willingness to learn German and achieve the language level required for professional recognition and employment.- Motivation to complete the professional recognition process in Germany.- Strong communication skills, empathy, patience, and a patient-focused approach.- Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.Opportunities for International ApplicantsDepending on the employer and individual circumstances, support may include:- Guidance with recognition of foreign professional qualifications.- Assistance with German language courses.- Information and support regarding visa and work permit procedures.- Relocation guidance and help with settling in Germany.- Assistance with accommodation arrangements, where available.- Opportunities for long-term professional development.What We Offer- Employment opportunities in Germany's healthcare sector.- A professional and supportive working environment.- Opportunities to develop clinical skills and gain international work experience.- Competitive salary based on qualifications, experience, location, and employer.- Potential long-term career opportunities in Germany.How to ApplyInterested candidates should submit:- An updated CV in English or German.- Copies of educational certificates and professional qualifications.- Evidence of relevant work experience, if available.- German language certificates, if available.- Information about current country of residence and willingness to relocate.Take the next step in your career and start your journey as an Ergotherapist in Germany!International candidates are encouraged to apply. Employment is subject to the applicable professional recognition, language, immigration, and work authorization requirements in Germany.Important information for applicants from abroadIn Germany, the profession of Ergotherapeut/in is regulated. Before working under the professional title, applicants generally need recognition of their foreign qualification and authorization to use the professional title.- Qualification recognition: The responsible authority depends on the German federal state where you intend to work.- German language: Employers and recognition authorities may require German proficiency. B2 is a useful target, although the exact requirements can vary.- Visa and relocation: Requirements depend on your nationality, qualifications, and circumstances.- Job opportunities: Hospitals, rehabilitation centres, private therapy practices, care facilities, and paediatric therapy centres may recruit international professionals.

jobs.occupation: Truck Driver (CE) for national long-distance routes – Germany (Berufskraftfahrer/in)

jobs.occupation: Team Assistant - Accounting & Internal Service (m/w/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: GAF Geospatial GmbH (GAF), an e-GEOS S.p.A. (Telespazio S.p.A./ASI) company, is a globally active provider of cross-platform geoinformation solutions and innovative Earth Observation applications. In addition to receiving and procuring satellite-based earth observation data, GAF holds a leading position in the areas of data processing and geo-consulting due to its 40 years of expertise. With an international and interdisciplinary team of experts, GAF sets standards for geospatial consulting, cloud- and AI-based data analysis, and satellite-based monitoring of the environment and natural resources in Europe and around the globe.To further strengthen our team at our headquarters in Munich, we are currently seeking a committedTeam Assistant - Accounting & Internal ServiceAs the first point of contact for our guests and suppliers, you represent our company with your warm and professional manner. You will take responsibility for a wide range of tasks relating to our reception and internal office organisation, and, together with colleagues and external partners, ensure that day-to-day operations run smoothly.In addition, you will support our finance team with selected accounting tasks. In this role, you will gain an insight into accounts receivable and accounts payable, support our senior accountants in their day-to-day work and, where required, cover for them during their annual leave.Your responsibilities:Reception & Office Coordination Responsibilities:- Answering and directing phone calls in a friendly manner, as well as organising post and courier deliveries- Greeting visitors and coordinating hospitality arrangements- Travel management: organising business trips and managing the travel booking and expense claims platform; providing assistance with visa applications and travel and security notifications where required- Monitoring and restocking office and kitchen supplies – you keep track of everything and know what is needed- Managing our company apartment, including the occupancy schedule, equipment & condition checks, in conjunction with our in-house technician- Support with the onboarding of new staff and an introduction to our office organisation- Coordinating with our cleaning services for both the office and company apartmentYour tasks in the area of accounting:- Recording and entering incoming invoices into our ERP system- Handling petty cash and related documentation- Support with travel expense claims, in particular the verification, entry and transfer of data from the travel management system to the ERP system- Issuing outgoing invoices and recording them in our ERP systemYour profile:- Completed commercial vocational training or equivalent qualification- Initial work experience in an assistant, office management or commercial role; some experience in bookkeeping is desirable- Understanding of travel expense regulations and travel management, particularly travel bookings and travel expense claims, would be an advantage- Structured, self-reliant and solution-focused working style- Friendly, professional attitude paired with a strong sense of teamwork- Excellent communication and organizational skills- High level of reliability, discretion, and dedication- Willingness to handle routine tasks conscientiously while staying open to new responsibilities- Genuine interest in improving and optimizing existing workflows- Confident user of standard MS Office applications- Very strong command of both German and English (written and spoken at CEFR level C1–C2)Desirable knowledge:- Knowledge of another foreign language (e.g. Italian or Spanish)- Class B driving licenseWhat to expect:- A responsible and varied role in one of Europe’s leading geo-information companies- Comprehensive support in familiarising yourself with your professional role- Training and development – because your experience and knowledge count- A respectful, friendly and modern working environment in a multi-national team of committed colleagues and a leadership style based on trust- An attractive location with perfect public transport connections and great options for outdoor and recreational activities in the direct vicinity- Various additional benefits, e.g. public transport contribution (job ticket), company pension scheme (optional), travel health insurance (worldwide), occupational health management, and much moreFurther information:- Place of work: Headquarters in Munich- Full-time position (40 hours per week)- Permanent position, starting at the earliest possible date

jobs.occupation: Big Data & Backend Engineer – Spatial ETL (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Backend Engineers; Data Engineers; Database AdministratorsStellenbeschreibung:Big Data & Backend Engineer – Spatial ETL (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, Database Administrators, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is a proprietary applied research initiative processing massive amounts of infrastructure and spatial data. We bridge the gap between fragmented public data and actionable infrastructure intelligence. When standard APIs reach their limits and entire national registries must be processed, you step in. In this role, you are the architect for heavy data loads and robust backend pipelines.  Your Focus & Responsibilities - Bulk Processing: Automate the download and processing of massive data dumps (e.g., corporate registers, industrial emission databases like PRTR, energy grids). - ETL Engineering: Program high-performance ETL pipelines that decompress, parse, and transfer complex archives into our central PostgreSQL architecture. - Database Governance: Ensure idempotency, deduplication, and reliable monitoring during weekly multi-million row updates. - Container Orchestration: Deploy and maintain isolated Docker environments for all ingestion tasks.  What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or extensive practical backend industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Expertise in processing relational mass data, strong Python skills (SQLAlchemy, Pandas), and deep PostgreSQL performance tuning. - Mindset: A clean-code engineering approach focused on system stability and scalability.  - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Modern Tech Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment centered on Python, PostGIS, and Docker.  How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Big Data & Backend Engineer)

jobs.occupation: Data Mining & OSINT Automation Specialist (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Software Engineers; Web Scrapers; OSINT SpecialistsStellenbeschreibung:Data Mining & OSINT Automation Specialist (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Software Engineers, Web Scrapers, OSINT Specialists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. Because not all valuable data exists as clean spatial polygons, we build systems that extract hidden knowledge from texts, complex web registries, and unstructured documents. In this role, you will build the autonomous agents that feed our intelligence engine.  Your Focus & Responsibilities - Web Automation: Develop scalable web scrapers and autonomous agents to extract data from unstructured sources (public registers, official announcements, corporate portals). - Data Parsing: Parse unstructured web and document data (JSON, XML, HTML, PDF) into clean, relational database structures. - Entity Extraction: Apply OCR, regex, and NLP techniques to extract structured entities (addresses, capacities, corporate connections) from dense documents. - Pipeline Monitoring: Automate monitoring scripts to continuously feed fresh data into our central PostGIS Data Lake. What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Proven experience in Web Scraping (Python, Playwright, Scrapy, Selenium, BeautifulSoup) and handling uncooperative web architectures. - Mindset: Analytical mindset with a drive for data cleaning, structural modeling, and robust automation. - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership.
